note: Second pass 1. The board re-set needs-audit-1 on 2026-09-21T06:00 after the arm landed. docs/audits/2026-09-20-primpv13-pass1.md holds the FIRST pass-1 record and was not overwritten; this record uses the same 'b' suffix convention as pass2b.

findings.summary: changed_region() hard-codes the perpendicular footprint while decisive_xy() is given the run's --extent-rule, so the scoping column 'outside' -- documented as 'It must be 0' -- is non-zero in the mode this diff now instructs every arm to use.
findings.scenario: Run the prediction's own THE JUDGED COMMAND (--extent-rule) on this arm's two result dirs: 'outside' is non-zero on 12 of 27 captures, rising with width to 9 px at w=63.875, with no explanation anywhere in the lane's record. The next reader either spends a cycle hunting an emulator scoping escape that does not exist, or learns to discount the column -- and the column is the only check for a real scoping escape.
findings.evidence: Confirmed by experiment: threading extent_rule through changed_region() (signature, the lp.field call at :159, the call site at :246) drives every 'outside' to 0 on all 27 captures and changes NO other number -- the eleven-class table and every per-capture decisive/moved/A!=B px are identical. Scratch copy deleted, not committed.
findings.remediation: Thread the footprint rule through changed_region(), or -- if the narrow region is wanted deliberately -- correct the footnote that says a non-zero value is a scoping bug.

findings.summary: The regeneration in be2cc09ec7 committed an operator's home directory into provenance.tests_root and provenance.support_dirs (/home/user/... -> /home/justin/...).
findings.scenario: No gate reads these: cmd_check compares symbols, sites and suites only (nv2a_index.py:1072, :1133) and nv2a_index.py:706 takes tests_root from the FRESHLY built index. So the cost is a one-line conflict in a shared board file whenever two machines regenerate, plus a home path in a public repository.
findings.remediation: Decision to log. The durable fix is in the generator (record a basename or nothing), not in this lane; master already carries /home/user/... from another host. 'Reviewed, not fixed, because the fix is in nv2a_index.py' is acceptable; silence is not.

findings.summary: report_rules()'s per-block table swapped opp_acb out for ours_patched; opp_acb is the one rival the goldens separate from the derived rule, and they separate it in exactly one block (QStrip, 100.00% vs 79.46%).
findings.scenario: A later edit that slid our order onto opp_acb still shows as a changed 'ours' column, so it is caught -- what is lost is seeing WHICH rival it slid to without re-running. The aggregate table above still scores all of SCHEMES, which is why this is LOW.
findings.remediation: Widen the row to five columns. One line.

findings.summary: The prediction requires its hand-judged table to be recorded in a '[lane.primpv13] arm judged:' PR comment AND appended to docs/lanes/primpv13/NOTES.md. This audit supplies the numbers and posts them on the PR; the NOTES.md half is a lane-file edit an auditor may not make.
findings.scenario: The arm's real result lives only in a review comment; the next reader of NOTES.md sees a predicted table with no measured one beside it and re-runs the judge, or folds on the [job.arms] PASS, which covers only the scoping legs.
findings.remediation: Append the eleven class rows from section A to docs/lanes/primpv13/NOTES.md.
